how to look up built-in strategy docs
title: Look up built-in strategies by API
summary: Use built_in_list, built_in_doc, and get_strategy_by_id to inspect built-ins. This card teaches the three lookup calls—not a full id catalog, and not live strategy_meta injection.
narrative:
qteasy ships many built-in strategies. Look them up with three calls:

- qt.built_in_list() — all ids, or pass a fuzzy string to filter.
- qt.built_in_doc(stg_id) — docstring for parameters and rules.
- qt.get_strategy_by_id(stg_id) — an instance you can add to an Operator.

After you have an id or instance, put it on an Operator with the Operator creation card. This card does not print the full ~70-id table; Ask can also answer a concrete id or an explicit list-builtins question via the live strategy_meta adapter. Ask never writes strategy files from this card.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
ids = qt.built_in_list()
print(ids[:5])
print(qt.built_in_doc('dma')[:200])
stg = qt.get_strategy_by_id('dma')
print(type(stg).__name__)
risk_notes: Do not mirror every built-in id into the KB. Prefer built_in_doc or Ask strategy_meta for a concrete id.
